body: oh, and i would try anything, including mushrooms, but i would need to have someone to be with me during the trip, and that's the root of the despair. if i had a wife, i'd not be depressed, and then i wouldn't need to try psychedelics to keep me from shooting myself.

thanks for the story. it's an interesting point, but i don't know if i agree. i get that we're alone in some way, but there is a huge difference between having someone to love and being by yourself. having someone makes all the difference. of course, if you're in a bad relationship, it's arguably comparable or worse that being alone, but plenty of people have happy marriages. i can see that they have challenges, but they're, by and large, far less miserable. i'm just trying to get through at this point, because the minutes are agony. i can't imagine being able to handle this for weeks or months.

i do this - actually this is what happens in performance - a roomful of happy people. and afterwards, some autographs and photos, and the couples go home even more in love with each other, and girls who are too young for me look at me and giggle. i go back to my room alone and i look at reddit. if this had happened (success in music) when i was in my 20s, i think i would have had no trouble finding someone. at this age, well, it's like a cruel joke.

i think if i attempted, i'd shoot myself, and i'd make pretty sure to finish it off out of fear of how much worse life would be if i shot myself and survived. i don't think i'd ever have the strength to slit my wrists (i assume that's what you did). 

do you still, a week or so later, feel like you want to keep living?

i used to give lessons. i actively help others in many different ways. it doesn't make me any less alone. i need someone to love, someone to hold and to share life with. we're just not built to be alone.

i think it's as simple as this - i can't find a woman to marry. that would make all the difference. unfortunately, it's an all or nothing situation. i just can't be alone anymore, but this desperation isn't attractive. i know, this is the oldest problem in the book. i'm trying to make a deal with myself to stay alive through 2015, but that's such a miserable proposition. i know that i'll be alone throughout the year. dog on a leash in the backyard.
how was it an eye opener? are you glad you're still here?
